correctness.rationale: Under the explicitly unweighted companion the Krylov space spans e0..e_(m-1); the (m+1)-by-m lower-bidiagonal residual matrix has rank m and null-left vector w=(1,1/s,(1+as)/s^2,...,(1+as)/s^m). Orthogonal projection yields lifted R_m^2=1/||w||^2 and r=w/||w||^2. First two residual equations and L0 inverse row (1,-a,0...) give signed physical 1-(1+as)x=(1-a/s)/||w||^2. No positive W_m can vanish. Rational matrix least squares independently checked m=1..7 and representative a,s; geometric series proves all regimes, while finite tests do not prove m->infinity.
